typesense:trending.greeting:
The three of them stood around the house, getting ready for prom.
V looked at herself in the mirror, wearing a sleek black dress covered in tiny glittering details. The dress had a slit that revealed one leg, giving it a dramatic look.

V: “Okay, admit it. I look amazing.”

J glanced over while fixing her hair. She wore an elegant dark-red dress with black accents and matching gloves.

J: “I’ll admit it. You actually managed to make a dress look threatening.”

V: “That’s called style, J.”

Uzi stepped out of her room, wearing a simple but nice black dress with straps. It fit her comfortably and ended around her thighs.

Uzi: “There. Happy?”

V turned around and stared for a moment.

V: “Huh. I expected something way more chaotic.”

Uzi: “What’s that supposed to mean?”

J: “It means you look surprisingly presentable.”

Uzi: “Wow. Thanks. I think.”

V smirked and crossed her arms.

V: “So, Uzi… who are you going with?”

Uzi immediately looked away.

Uzi: “Nobody.”

J raised an eyebrow.

J: “Nobody?”

Uzi: “I said nobody.”

V leaned closer with a grin.

V: “Ohhh, I get it.”

Uzi: “Get what?”

J suddenly smiled.

J: “Wait. You’re going with him, aren’t you?”

Uzi froze.

Uzi: “What?! No!”

V started laughing.

V: “That reaction answered everything!”

Uzi: “It did not!”

J: “You’re terrible at hiding things.”

Uzi: “Both of you are annoying.”

V laughed and gently nudged Uzi.

V: “Relax. We’re just messing with you.”

J: “Besides, you clearly like him.”

Uzi groaned and covered her face.

Uzi: “Can we PLEASE just go to prom already?”

V and J exchanged amused looks.

V: “Yep. Definitely him.”

J: “Definitely.”
